upgrades.label: Rooftop solar
upgrades.description: Sized to the usable roof (never above the hotel's yearly electricity use). Output comes from the location's solar data; the hotel uses what it can hour by hour and any surplus is exported at the region's export credit.
upgrades.source: Sizing: PLACEHOLDER usable roof share (0.5) and roof area per kW (100 ft2). Output: the climate's solar data. Cost: the region's installed cost per W. Degradation: 0.5% a year, the median reported by Jordan and Kurtz, 'Photovoltaic Degradation Rates: An Analytical Review', Progress in Photovoltaics (2013), to be verified. Operation and maintenance and inverter replacement are not included.

source: PLACEHOLDER, synthetic. All upgrade savings, costs, lifetimes and interaction factors are illustrative until replaced with sourced values (docs/11 Phase 7).
